paite: Israelte tung ah Pathian ahoih ngei e, lungtang siangthoute tung ah.
heading: Asaph La / BU THUMΝΑ / (Sam 73-89) / Pathian Thukhenna Dik
english: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

paite: Himahleh ke'n zaw ka siktal dekdek a; ka kalsuante ateu dekdek ahi.
english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

paite: Migilou-saloute vangphatdan ka muh in mi ki-uangsakte ka eng hi.
english: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

paite: Asih lai un thuakgimna anei kei ua, ahatna uh akip zosop hi.
english: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

paite: Midang bang a gimthuak in a-om kei uhi. Midang bang a gawt in leng a-om sam kei uh.
english: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

paite: Huaiziak in kisaktheihna in khainiang bang in angawng uh avial a; hiamgamna in puan bang in atuam hi.
english: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

paite: Thau ziak in amit uh apawng leuluau a, lungtang thudeih sang a thupi anei uhi.
english: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

paite: Anuihsan ua, giloutak in nuaisiahna thu agen ua, kisaktheihna in apau uhi.
english: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

paite: Akam uh van lam ah akoih ua, alei un leitung apha suak zel hi.
english: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

paite: Huaiziak in amite huai ah akik nawn ua, tui nou dim adawnsiang sipsip uhi.
english: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

paite: Pathian in bangchi in athei dia? Tungnungpen in theihna anei dia hia? achi uhi.
english: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

paite: En dih, hiai migilou-saloute ahi uh; nuamsa a om in ahau deuhdeuh uhi.
english: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

paite: Athawn in ka lungtang ka hihsiang a, ka khutte gensiatbei in ka sil hi.
english: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

paite: Nitum in gawt in ka om a, zingsang teng in sawi in ka om hi.
english: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

paite: Huchibang in ka gen ding, na chi taleng; ngai dih, muanhuai loutak a hih ka hi ding.
english: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

paite: Huai ka theihna ding dan ka ngaihtuah in, kei a ding in ana lua hi.
english: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

paite: Pathian' mun siangthou a ka lut a, abeina ding uh ka ngaihtuah masiah.
english: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

paite: Amau mun naltak ah na koih a; siatnate ah na paikhe zel hi.
english: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

paite: Bangchidan ahia mitphiat kal kia a a-ingamtak uh aw! Thil mulkimhuaitakte a hihmanthat vek in a-omta uhi.
english: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

paite: Mi'n khanloh nung a mang bangmah asak louh bang un, TOUPA aw, na halh hun in amau lim leng bangmah na sa kei ding hi.
english: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

paite: Ka lungsim lungkham a a-om a, ka lungtang a sut a ka om lai in.
english: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

paite: Mimawl leh bangmah thei lou ka hi a, na lak ah gamsa bang phet ka hi hial hi.
english: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

paite: Himahleh na kiang ah ka om gige a, ka khut taklam na len gige hi.
english: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

paite: Nang na lemtheihna in na hon pi ding a, huai nung chiang in thupina ah na hon tun ding hi.
english: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

paite: Van ah nang lou kua ka nei a? Lei ah leng nang lou ngal ka deih kuamah a-om kei hi.
english: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

paite: Ka sa leh ka lungtang abahta a, himahleh Pathian tangtawn a ka lungtang utna ding leh ka tantuan ding ahi.
english: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

paite: Ngai in, nangmah gamlat a omte amangthang dek ua; ahon angkawmsan peuhmahte na hihmangta ahi.
english: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

paite: Himahleh kei a ding in bel Pathian naih ahoih hi; Toupa PATHIAN ka kihumbitna in ka nei a, na nasep tengteng ka puanzak theihna ding in.
english: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
